quarterly_data.signal: EMCOR's 10-Q splits remaining performance obligations at June 30, 2026 by segment: U.S. electrical construction and facilities services $6,271,919 thousand (36%) and U.S. mechanical construction and facilities services $9,366,637 thousand (55%), versus $11.91 billion total RPO at June 30, 2025; $13,023,427 thousand of total RPO is expected to be recognized within one year. RPO increased by $3.89 billion from December 31, 2025 due to new contract awards within the U.S. construction segments and the U.S. building services segment; network and communications, predominantly as a result of several data center construction contracts, is listed first among the sectors with the most significant increases.
